Bug class #4 (wrong exit code). Failure paths returned { error } -> host exit 0; also a fully-malformed JSONL imported 0 yet exited 0.
Repro (before fix):
  pm beads import /tmp/nope.jsonl ; echo $? -> 0
  pm beads import ; echo $?              -> 0
  pm beads import bad.jsonl ; echo $?    -> 0 (every line unparseable)
Expected: non-zero.
Fix: throw on no-arg and read failure; throw when imported===0 && skipped>0 (whole file failed). Partial imports stay lenient (exit 0).
Verified: missing-file/no-arg/fully-malformed all exit 1; 1-good-1-bad exits 0.
beads import returns error object instead of throwing (exit 0 on failure + malformed file)
